tools.name: convert_image
tools.description: Convert an image to JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, for example an iPhone HEIC photo to JPEG. Writes a new file next to the input (name-converted.ext) unless output is given, never replaces a file unless overwrite is true, and returns the path, format and size change.

output.description: Where to write. Default: next to the input, like photo-resized.jpg

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default false

quality.description: Quality for lossy output (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. PNG ignores it

path.description: Absolute path (or ~/…) of the image to read: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC. HEIC is written as JPEG unless a format is chosen.

tools.name: resize_image
tools.description: Resize an image, keeping its aspect ratio. Give width, height, both (the image fits inside that box) or percent. Writes a new file next to the input (name-resized.ext) unless output is given, never replaces a file unless overwrite is true, and returns the path, format and size change.

output.description: Where to write. Default: next to the input, like photo-resized.jpg

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default false

quality.description: Quality for lossy output (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. PNG ignores it

path.description: Absolute path (or ~/…) of the image to read: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC. HEIC is written as JPEG unless a format is chosen.

percent.description: Scale in percent, like 50 for half size

tools.name: compress_image
tools.description: Make an image file smaller in its own format. Never returns a bigger file. Writes a new file next to the input (name-compressed.ext) unless output is given, never replaces a file unless overwrite is true, and returns the path, format and size change.

output.description: Where to write. Default: next to the input, like photo-resized.jpg

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default false

quality.description: Quality for lossy output (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. PNG ignores it

path.description: Absolute path (or ~/…) of the image to read: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC. HEIC is written as JPEG unless a format is chosen.

maxKb.description: Target file size in KB. Without it, a sensible quality is used

tools.name: watermark_image
tools.description: Draw a text watermark on an image, in one corner or tiled across it. Writes a new file next to the input (name-watermarked.ext) unless output is given, never replaces a file unless overwrite is true, and returns the path, format and size change.

output.description: Where to write. Default: next to the input, like photo-resized.jpg

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default false

quality.description: Quality for lossy output (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. PNG ignores it

path.description: Absolute path (or ~/…) of the image to read: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC. HEIC is written as JPEG unless a format is chosen.

size.description: Text height as % of the short side. Default 5

tools.name: generate_thumbnail
tools.description: Make a small preview that fits inside a square box. Default 256 px WebP. Writes a new file next to the input (name-thumb.ext) unless output is given, never replaces a file unless overwrite is true, and returns the path, format and size change.

output.description: Where to write. Default: next to the input, like photo-resized.jpg

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default false

quality.description: Quality for lossy output (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. PNG ignores it

path.description: Absolute path (or ~/…) of the image to read: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC. HEIC is written as JPEG unless a format is chosen.

tools.name: crop_image
tools.description: Crop an image to a centred aspect ratio (ratio) or to a region (box). Give one of them. Writes a new file next to the input (name-cropped.ext) unless output is given, never replaces a file unless overwrite is true, and returns the path, format and size change.

output.description: Where to write. Default: next to the input, like photo-resized.jpg

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default false

quality.description: Quality for lossy output (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. PNG ignores it

path.description: Absolute path (or ~/…) of the image to read: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC. HEIC is written as JPEG unless a format is chosen.

box.description: Region to keep, as fractions of the image

tools.name: rotate_image
tools.description: Rotate an image clockwise by a quarter turn or more, and optionally mirror it. Writes a new file next to the input (name-rotated.ext) unless output is given, never replaces a file unless overwrite is true, and returns the path, format and size change.

output.description: Where to write. Default: next to the input, like photo-resized.jpg

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default false

quality.description: Quality for lossy output (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. PNG ignores it

path.description: Absolute path (or ~/…) of the image to read: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC. HEIC is written as JPEG unless a format is chosen.

tools.name: blur_image
tools.description: Blur a whole image, or only some areas of it (faces, plates, text). Writes a new file next to the input (name-blurred.ext) unless output is given, never replaces a file unless overwrite is true, and returns the path, format and size change.

output.description: Where to write. Default: next to the input, like photo-resized.jpg

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default false

quality.description: Quality for lossy output (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. PNG ignores it

path.description: Absolute path (or ~/…) of the image to read: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC. HEIC is written as JPEG unless a format is chosen.

areas.description: Blur only these regions. Default: the whole image

items.description: Fractions of the image, 0–1, from the top left

tools.name: remove_metadata
tools.description: Remove location, camera and other hidden data. Lossless for JPEG, PNG and WebP; orientation is kept. HEIC and AVIF are re-encoded as JPEG, which can be bigger than the original. Writes a new file next to the input (name-clean.ext) unless output is given, never replaces a file unless overwrite is true, and returns the path, format and size change.

output.description: Where to write. Default: next to the input, like photo-resized.jpg

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default false

quality.description: Quality for lossy output (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. PNG ignores it

path.description: Absolute path (or ~/…) of the image to read: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC. HEIC is written as JPEG unless a format is chosen.

tools.name: merge_images
tools.description: Combine images side by side or stacked, scaled to the smallest shared edge. Writes a new file next to the input (name-merged.ext) unless output is given, never replaces a file unless overwrite is true, and returns the path, format and size change.

output.description: Where to write. Default: next to the input, like photo-resized.jpg

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Default false

quality.description: Quality for lossy output (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. PNG ignores it

paths.description: Absolute paths (or ~/…) of the images, in order

background.description: Colour of the gap and any empty space. Default white
